title: Yeasty Crispy Slovakian Yoghurt Bowl
description: Traditional Slovakian breakfast dish featuring sautéed ingredients in a crunchy Korean brass bowl served over natural yoghurt. Perfect for a quick and nutritious morning meal.

ingredients.name: Coarse Ground Rye Flour
ingredients.notes: For crunchy base of the Korean brass bowl

ingredients.name: Sautéed Onions
ingredients.notes: Sautéed in 1 tablespoon of Olive Oil at 150°C for 8 minutes until caramelized

ingredients.name: Sautéed Mushrooms
ingredients.notes: Sautéed in 1 tablespoon of Olive Oil at 150°C for 6 minutes until golden brown

instructions: Spread a thin layer of the coarse ground rye flour onto the bottom of a Korean brass bowl
Sauté the onions in olive oil until caramelized then set aside
Sauté the mushrooms in olive oil until golden brown then set aside
Spread the mashed carrots over the rye flour base of the bowl
Top the carrots with the sautéed onions and mushrooms
Add a dollop of natural yoghurt on top of the onions and mushrooms
Garnish with chopped fresh dill if desired and/or top with a slice of Slovakian rye bread or sesame seeds for added crunch
